name: G9 T3 W02 - Online dangers
description: Study these five words across this week. Complete Flashcards, Matching and Fill in Blank once. Then choose additional practice. Reuse this pool throughout the week. Follow your separate class instructions.

words.definition: A trick that uses a fake message or website to steal private information.
words.example: The phishing message asks for the school-account password.

words.definition: Software made to harm a device, disrupt it or steal information.
words.example: The unsafe download installs malware on the computer.

words.definition: Malware that blocks access to files or a device and demands payment.
words.example: The ransomware locks the project files and demands money.

words.definition: A secret set of characters used to help prove that someone may access an account.
words.example: Keep your password private when a message asks you to share it.

words.definition: An action or safeguard that reduces the chance or harm of a problem.
words.example: A separate backup provides protection against losing the only project copy.
